# Pinned tooling for the documentation build (.github/workflows/docs.yml) and for
# local use:
#   pip install -r .github/requirements/docs.txt
#   mkdocs build --strict --config-file .github/mkdocs-ci.yml
# mkdocs is held at 1.x on purpose: Material for MkDocs says MkDocs 2.0 will
# break its theme and plugin system. Dependabot's pip ecosystem for
# /.github/requirements keeps these current, and a major MkDocs bump is its own
# pull request.
mkdocs==1.6.1
mkdocs-material==9.7.7
